info.title: claim-service
info.description: The policy read model used for claims, and from M5b claim intake (M5a).

tags.name: Policies
tags.description: The customer's policies, as claims see them (M5a).

tags.name: Review
tags.description: Staff: the review queue and the decision on a claim (M6).

tags.name: Claims
tags.description: Claims: the customer's draft, submit, withdraw and follow-up (M5b, M6).

get.description: A customer reads their own claim with its checks. A reviewer reads a claim of their own insurer, with the soft flags and the payable estimate.

404.description: No such claim for you or your insurer (CLAIM_NOT_FOUND)

put.description: Replaces the details of a draft.

409.description: The claim is no longer a draft (CLAIM_NOT_EDITABLE)

get.description: Your claims, newest first. The checks are shown on GET by id, not in the list.

post.description: Creates a DRAFT against one of your policies. Nothing is checked against the policy until you submit it.

409.description: The policy's terms are not available (POLICY_UNUSABLE)

post.description: Withdraws a draft or a submitted claim.

409.description: The claim can no longer be withdrawn (INVALID_TRANSITION)

post.description: Runs the automatic checks. A claim that passes is SUBMITTED and sent for review. A claim that fails is REJECTED at once; the response lists each check and the reason.

200.description: The claim, SUBMITTED or REJECTED, with its checks

409.description: Only a draft can be submitted (INVALID_TRANSITION, POLICY_UNUSABLE)

post.description: Moves a SUBMITTED claim to UNDER_REVIEW and stores what the evaluator says is payable.

403.description: Not staff, or your own claim (FORBIDDEN, SELF_REVIEW_NOT_ALLOWED)

404.description: No such claim at your insurer (CLAIM_NOT_FOUND)

post.description: Returns a claim to review after a reviewer asked for more information. Upload any new documents first; they are accepted while the claim waits.

post.summary: Ask the customer for more information
post.description: Moves a claim under review to INFO_REQUESTED and tells the customer what is needed.

200.description: The claim, waiting for the customer

403.description: Not staff, or your own claim (FORBIDDEN, SELF_REVIEW_NOT_ALLOWED)

404.description: No such claim at your insurer (CLAIM_NOT_FOUND)

post.description: Moves a claim under review to REJECTED, with a reason the customer sees.

403.description: Not staff, or your own claim (FORBIDDEN, SELF_REVIEW_NOT_ALLOWED)

404.description: No such claim at your insurer (CLAIM_NOT_FOUND)

get.summary: List the documents of my claim

post.description: Adds a PDF, JPEG or PNG of up to 10 MB to a draft claim. The file's first bytes must match its declared type. At most 10 documents per claim.

parameters.name: docType
parameters.description: What the document proves, upper case, for example INVOICE.

schema.description: What the document proves, upper case, for example INVOICE.

409.description: Not a draft, or too many documents (CLAIM_NOT_EDITABLE, DOCUMENT_LIMIT_REACHED)

415.description: Not a PDF, JPEG or PNG (DOCUMENT_TYPE_NOT_ALLOWED)

422.description: The content does not match the type (DOCUMENT_CONTENT_MISMATCH)

post.description: Evaluates the policy's limits and approves for payment: the full payable amount, or a smaller amount with a reason, never more. The approved amount is reserved against the limits. Above the configured threshold only an admin can approve.

403.description: Not staff, your own claim, or above your threshold (FORBIDDEN, SELF_REVIEW_NOT_ALLOWED, ADMIN_APPROVAL_REQUIRED)

404.description: No such claim at your insurer (CLAIM_NOT_FOUND)

409.description: Not under review, or limits changed at once (INVALID_TRANSITION, CONFLICT)

422.description: More than payable, no reason for a partial amount, or nothing left under the limits (APPROVAL_EXCEEDS_PAYABLE, PARTIAL_APPROVAL_REASON_REQUIRED, COUNT_LIMIT_REACHED, LIMIT_EXHAUSTED)

get.description: Every status change, oldest first. Customers see their own; reviewers their insurer's.

404.description: No such claim for you or your insurer (CLAIM_NOT_FOUND)

get.summary: A link to download a document
get.description: A presigned URL that expires after five minutes. Only the claim's owner gets one.

200.description: The link and when it expires

404.description: No such claim or document of yours (CLAIM_NOT_FOUND, DOCUMENT_NOT_FOUND)

get.description: Claims awaiting review for your insurer (every insurer for a platform admin), flagged claims first, then oldest first. Pass status (for example PAYOUT_FAILED) to list claims in that status instead.

400.description: Bad paging parameters or unknown status (VALIDATION_FAILED)

get.description: The policies claim-service has received events for, newest cover first. A policy that is still awaiting payment is not listed; GET by id can still answer for it.
Answers from the read model. If the event has not arrived yet, policy-service is asked. Anyone else's policy, or an unknown one, is 404.

503.description: policy-service unavailable (POLICY_UNAVAILABLE). Retry-After tells you when to try again.

ClaimDetails.description: The details of a claim, as the customer states them.

AssessmentView.description: One automatic check and its outcome.

ClaimResponse.description: A claim, with its details, status and automatic check results.

rejectionReason.description: Why the claim was rejected, when it was.

amountApproved.description: What was approved for payment, once a reviewer has approved.

decisionReason.description: The reviewer's reason: for a rejection, a partial approval or a request.

amountEligible.description: Reviewers only: what the evaluator says can be paid.

flagged.description: Reviewers only: true when a soft flag was raised.

reviewerId.description: Reviewers only: who last acted on the claim.

CreateClaimRequest.description: Starts a claim as a DRAFT against one of the customer's policies.

policyId.description: The policy the claim is against.

RequestInfoRequest.description: Asks the customer for more information about a claim.

approvedAmount.description: Leave out to approve the full payable amount.

reason.description: Required when approving less than the payable amount.

StatusChangeView.description: One status change of a claim.

DownloadUrlView.description: A time-limited link to download one document.

PolicyView.description: A policy the customer holds, with the terms it was sold with.
